title: Acceptance bound from small influences
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $0\leq\delta,\varepsilon\leq1$ with $\varepsilon\leq\delta$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to[-1,1]$. If every coordinate has stable influence at most $\varepsilon$ at parameter $1-\varepsilon$, then the Håstad tester acceptance probability at noise parameter $\delta$ is at most $\frac12+\frac12\sqrt{\varepsilon}$.
hypotheses_covered: Every coordinate's stable influence at parameter $1-\varepsilon$ is at most $\varepsilon$
